entities.summary: Edward Joseph Johnston is a Canadian former professional ice hockey goaltender, coach, and general manager in the National Hockey League. His professional career spanned fifty-three years, mostly in the NHL. He won two Stanley Cups as a player with the Boston Bruins in 1970 and 1972, and three as senior advisor for hockey operations with the Pittsburgh Penguins, an organization he worked in various capacities for twenty-five years. He was the last NHL goaltender to play every minute of every game in a season, in 1963–64.
